description: This file defines the EmploymentContractAPI class for managing employment contract data via REST API endpoints in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, updating, and handling employment contract attachments associated with employee records.

classes.name: EmploymentContractAPI
classes.description: API class for managing employee employment contract data, including retrieval, update, and attachment handling within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieve a specific employee's employment contract by employee number.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Validation rules for fetching a single employment contract.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Update employment contract details for a specific employee, including contract dates and attachments.

methods.name: updateEmploymentContract
methods.description: Internal method to update the contract's start/end dates and save changes.

methods.name: updateContractAttachment
methods.description: Handle the attachment upload, replacement, or deletion for a given employee contract.

methods.name: setAttachmentAttributes
methods.description: Set file-related attributes for an employee attachment from a base64 encoded content.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validation rules for updating an employment contract.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Method not implemented; intended for deleting employment contracts.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Validation rules for delete operation; currently not implemented.
